extDescription.message: Save the page you are reading to FixNote in one click. It goes into the right folder by itself, encrypted with your key.

errorPro.message: Saving from the browser is part of FixNote Pro. Open FixNote → Settings → Plan.

errorNotPaired.message: This browser is no longer connected to FixNote. Connect it again in the extension's options.

errorTooMany.message: Too many saves in a minute. Try again shortly.

errorFailed.message: Could not save to FixNote. Check the connection and try again.

errorPage.message: This page cannot be saved (browser pages and files).

socialHow.message: When you press the site's own Save or Bookmark, the post goes to FixNote too. Only on the sites you turn on here.

startBody.message: Connect the extension to your FixNote account. It takes a few seconds.

feature1.message: One click or Alt+Shift+S saves the page you are reading.

feature2.message: FixNote puts it into the right folder by itself.

feature3.message: Encrypted here in the browser with your key: our server cannot read it.

connectNote.message: FixNote opens and asks you to confirm.

errorConnect.message: Could not reach FixNote. Check the connection and try again.

waitBody.message: FixNote shows a request. Connect only if it shows this code:

deniedBody.message: The request was denied in FixNote.

expiredBody.message: The request has expired. Press Try again and confirm in FixNote within a few minutes.
